messages:
mira (designer): Quick design check — compact roles matrix on org settings: when you collapse columns on <768px, focus order jumps. Also invite drawer CTA copy feels ambiguous. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/s/compact-matrix.png

sam (frontend): thanks — can you paste repro steps? I can't hit it locally.

mira (designer): repro: go to Settings > Access > Roles, toggle "Compact view", then Tab through header cells. Focus goes from "Role name" to "Save" button skipping checkboxes.

jo (a11y): sounds like a tabindex issue. Likely because header uses role=button for collapse. We should keep checkboxes in DOM order and hide visually with `aria-hidden` instead of removing. Also change the invite CTA to "Invite teammates" not just "Invite".

sam (frontend): adding a quick patch idea: keep checkboxes, add `visually-hidden` class for small screens, and ensure `tabindex=0` on each checkbox wrapper. Will prototype.

alex (product): agree on copy. "Invite teammates" better. Also want SSO toggle label clearer: currently "Enforce SSO" vs "Require SSO for all users" — prefer latter.

taylor (pm): noted — any impact on analytics? we track CTA clicks by `invite_click` event. If we change copy, we'll need to update event mapping. @sam can you add a migration label?

sam (frontend): yep, will keep the same event name internally but update ui_string property. No analytics break.

mira (designer): small accessibility nits: color contrast for the disabled role chips is 2.8:1 — needs to be >=3:1 for large text. Also hover states missing focus outline on keyboard nav.

jo (a11y): +1. Recommend 4.5:1 for small text where possible. I'll attach contrast swatches. Also suggest using `outline: 3px solid var(--focus)` instead of box-shadow for consistent focus.

qa-bot: Deploy preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/changes/1838771234 (build 827) — includes compact-matrix branch.

sam (frontend): pushed branch `compact-matrix-a11y` with initial fixes. PR #452.

mira (designer): looks good in preview. One micro-copy ask: change "People" column header to "Members" for clarity in org context.

alex (product): Members is fine. final decision: Members + Invite teammates CTA + SSO label to "Require SSO for org".

taylor (pm): action items: Sam fix DOM order + focus, Jo provide updated focus token, Mira update copy in figma, Alex confirm wording in release notes. I'll add to the sprint board.

mira (designer): thanks all! I'll put a small a11y checklist in the PR description :heart: 

sam (frontend): will merge after tests. ETA EOD tomorrow.

jo (a11y): I'll do a quick post-merge audit once deployed.

mira (designer): closing loop — thanks everyone :sparkles:
